totals: Accessible name of the row of stat tiles at the top of the Knowledge section (Spaces, pages, searches, dataset access).
none: In place of a table while the analytics store has no numbers yet.
ms: A duration in milliseconds on a stat tile; {{n}} is the number of milliseconds.
tiles.pages: Stat tile label: how many pages the workspace's Spaces hold. "Space" is a product noun (a shared area of pages).
tiles.pages-note: Under the Pages tile: {{n}} pages created in the range shown.
tiles.chars: Stat tile label: the average length of a page, in characters.
tiles.chars-note: Under the Average length tile: the unit of its number (characters per page).
tiles.edits: Stat tile label: how many page edits were made in the range.
tiles.edits-note: Under the Edits tile: {{n}} is how many different people made them.
tiles.stale: Stat tile label: pages nobody edited or used for a long time.
tiles.stale-note: Under the Stale pages tile: what makes a page stale. {{days}} is the threshold in days.
tiles.searches: Stat tile label: page searches made in the range.
tiles.searches-note: Under the Searches tile: {{n}} searches that returned no result.
tiles.search-p95: Stat tile label: the time 95% of page searches took at most (the 95th percentile).
tiles.search-p95-note: Under the search time tile: {{time}} is the median search time (already formatted, e.g. "12 ms").
tiles.access: Stat tile label: how many times datasets were read or changed in the range.
tiles.access-note: Under the Dataset access tile: how many different datasets.
tiles.denied: Stat tile label: dataset accesses that were refused.
tiles.denied-note: Under the Access denied tile: accesses that failed with an error.
spaces.title: Card heading: the workspace's Spaces (a product noun: shared areas of pages).
spaces.description: Card description. "Space" is a product noun.
spaces.show-all: Link that removes the Space filter and shows every Space again.
spaces.pages: Column heading: how many pages the Space has.
spaces.length: Column heading (short): average page length in characters.
spaces.edits: Column heading: edits in the range.
spaces.stale: Column heading: how many of its pages are stale (untouched for a long time).
pages.title: Card heading, and the accessible name of its list of pages.
pages.stale: Badge on a page that nobody edited or used for a long time.
pages.chars: A page's length in characters, in its row.
pages.edits: How many times a page was edited in the range, in its row.
pages.active: In a page's row: when it was last edited or used. {{when}} is a date and time.
search.title: Card heading: page searches (the search over Spaces' pages).
search.chart: Accessible name of the bar chart of searches per day.
search.x: Chart axis name, lowercase: each bar is a day.
search.y: Chart axis name, lowercase: the number of searches.
access.title: Card heading: reads and changes of datasets (tables of data).
access.actor: Badge: {{actor}} is one of access.actors.*, {{n}} how many accesses it made.
access.actors.user: Each access.actors.*: who accessed datasets. People: people in the workspace.
access.actors.dot: Socios: AI agents ("socio" is a product noun).
access.actors.token: Apps and computers using an access token.
access.actors.system: Socio itself (the app), for automatic work.
access.chats: Badge: in how many chats the datasets were accessed.
access.action: Column heading: what was done (a technical action name, e.g. query).
access.outcome: Column heading: how it went (ok, denied…, shown as is).
datasets.title: Card heading, and the accessible name of its list of datasets.
datasets.scratch: Badge on a socio's scratch dataset (temporary working data).
datasets.history: A dataset's size: {{size}} its data, {{history}} the kept history of its rows (both formatted sizes, e.g. "3 MB").
datasets.tables: How many tables a dataset has.
datasets.uses: How many times a dataset was accessed in the range.
datasets.denied: {{uses}} is datasets.uses; {{n}} how many of the accesses were refused.
datasets.last: When a dataset was last accessed. {{when}} is a date and time.
